data.name: Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Chapter V: Full Metal Law
data.detailed_description:
Welcome back to court in the world where all anime genres exist at once in NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, CHAPTER V: FULL METAL LAW, the thrilling follow-up to NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, CHAPTER IV: SACRED FEATHERS and next chapter in the NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE story!

Step into Nina Aquila's shoes once more for NALE's classic investigation/courtroom drama gameplay, in an epic war story that pays homage to classic "real robot" anime, mixing tactical espionage action and strategic mecha battles!

 

Engage in tactical espionage action! Investigate enemy strongholds & search for clues while evading enemies and outfoxing security systems in third-person action sections!

 

"Get in the robot" and command your team of pilots at the front, in missions to secure objectives and recon vital intelligence. In classic turn-based SRPG style, defeat your opponents to achieve battlefield supremacy, and uncover the truth!

 

Defend your client and fight for the truth in a new legal arena, a military court!

But be warned; the court of military justice does not suffer fools gladly.

Be prepared for new faces, higher stakes and stricter penalties! 

 

Experience the fifth chapter in Nina's ongoing story!

Months have passed since Nina & Dylan helped the Valiant Valkyries in their struggle, and as fall comes to an end, Fledge City shivers in the icy grip of a record-breaking winter.

Yet when a military operation from the Great Northern War goes awry, Aquila Defense & Law is forced to provide sanctuary for a wayward soldier, one who, it transpires, needs a lawyer - fast.

The war does not go well. The blizzard has brought a break in the stalemate, turning Fledge City itself into the next battleground. With forces on each side arming themselves for bear, the city shudders under the boom of cannon-fire and missile blast, as its streets become a flashpoint that could consume the entire world!

As the situation deteriorates, Nina finds herself caught between both sides of the conflict, and before she knows it, she's fighting shoulder-to-shoulder with heroes who stride across the battlefield in mighty, towering robots. 

In this world of fire and iron, where great and terrible war machines stomp to a rhythm of savagery that masquerades as valour, can Nina find the courage and determination to answer the conundrum that lies within the way of the warrior?

Can there truly be honour in victory?

And can justice be found in defeat?

Find out in this latest chapter of Nina's story: FULL METAL LAW!

 

  • Hybrid VN/Graphic Adventure/steal action/SRPG gameplay with hours of story-driven content

  • Pacing, presentation & tone that celebrates the Real Robot anime genre

  • Defend your client in court by cross-examining witnesses

  • Uncover evidence in stealth-action sections

  • Attain victory in SRPG sections

  • Explore a Mode7-style overworld

  • Accessibility features, including options to reduce effects for photosensitive users, and an "always-win" option for minigames to facilitate casual play

Step into court once again as Nina Aquila, and defend your clients in a world where all anime genres exist at once!

data.short_description: War comes to NINA AQUILA's world! Experience a new story of tactical espionage, turn-based strategy and military justice, as a war rages that threatens to turn Fledge City to dust!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: WindowsR 7/8/8.1/10 (32bit/64bit)
  • Processor: i5–7400 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or better
  • Storage: 1200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Older i3/i5 systems with onboard graphics may experience performance issues. We recommend systems with a dedicated graphics card.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX1660 SUPER or better
  • Storage: 1200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Most gaming systems from ~2019 or later with a dedicated graphics card should be able to run the game to an acceptable level.

  • Additional Notes: Older i3/i5 systems with onboard graphics may experience performance issues. We recommend systems with a dedicated graphics card.
